quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 3,659,907,017.15, up 9.66%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 720,204,539.60, up 38.32%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 677,544,470.60, up 44.53%. Quarterly revenue Q1-Q4: RMB 823,874,564.84 / 907,646,249.47 / 966,546,317.60 / 961,839,885.24; quarterly net profit attributable RMB 140,992,818.63 / 170,049,544.56 / 208,375,325.69 / 200,786,850.72 (Q4 up 39.07%). Operating cash flow RMB 1,156,538,766.70, up 39.64%. The company attributes the growth to deeper penetration of its CMP polishing materials and display materials at mainstream domestic fabs and panel makers, early volume sales of advanced packaging materials and cost control; wafer photoresist and advanced packaging materials were still loss-making in their early ramp, and share-based payment expense of RMB 4,552 ten-thousand reduced net profit attributable by RMB 4,203 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP polishing pads: 2025 product sales RMB 10.91 hundred million, up 52.34%; Q4 RMB 2.96 hundred million, up 53.4%; monthly pad sales passed 4 ten-thousand pads for the first time in 2025. Hard pads: cooperation intent reached with several overseas customers with product introduction under way, and promotion to foreign-owned fabs in China continues; the Wuhan hard-pad line reached about 5 ten-thousand pads a month (about 60 ten-thousand a year) by the end of Q1 2026, with utilization rising. Soft pads: entered large-silicon-wafer, third-generation semiconductor and advanced packaging markets with orders; Qianjiang profitability improving. Raw materials: prepolymer in stable in-house supply and the Xiantao microsphere line in mass production at high yield. The pad subsidiary Dinghui Microelectronics had 2025 revenue of RMB 1,092,839,398.15.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 pad sales RMB 10.91 hundred million (+52.34%); Q4 RMB 2.96 hundred million (+53.4%); Wuhan hard pads about 5 ten-thousand a month (about 60 ten-thousand a year) at end of Q1 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP slurries and cleaning solutions: 2025 product sales RMB 2.94 hundred million, up 36.84%; Q4 RMB 9,132 ten-thousand, up 21.72%. Copper and copper-barrier slurries (on in-house silica abrasives) won their first orders; metal-gate (tungsten, aluminum) slurries grew at existing customers with new models passing validation; several shallow-trench-isolation slurries (in-house ceria abrasive) are in the final stage of validation; polysilicon and silicon-nitride slurries keep ramping. A mainstream domestic logic fab placed a combined slurry-plus-cleaning-solution order (polysilicon slurry with matching cleaning solution). The company makes four abrasive systems in house (ultra-pure silica sol, high-purity silica sol, alumina, ceria).
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 sales RMB 2.94 hundred million (+36.84%); Q4 RMB 9,132 ten-thousand (+21.72%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor display materials: 2025 product sales RMB 5.44 hundred million, up 35.47%; Q4 RMB 1.31 hundred million, up 9.14%. PSPI volume rose sharply with record monthly shipments, YPI volume grew steadily and TFE-INK is in continued ramp; overseas validation is under way. The Xiantao 1,000-ton-a-year PSPI line is in production with stable volume supply, and the Xiantao 800-ton-a-year YPI phase-2 project was completed and is in trial operation. Several products passed validation on customers' G8.6 lines. The display subsidiary Rouxian Technology had 2025 revenue of RMB 563,446,552.04.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: High-end wafer photoresist (immersion ArF and KrF): as of the reporting period the company had over 30 grades, over 20 sampled with customers and over 12 in gallon-sample testing; ArF and KrF each won new orders in 2025 and 3 products were in stable volume supply. The Qianjiang phase-1 30-ton-a-year line runs stably; the main plant and facilities of the phase-2 300-ton-a-year line were completed, which the company calls China's first full-process (organic synthesis, polymer synthesis, purification, blending) wafer photoresist line. Construction in progress on the 300-ton KrF/ArF photoresist project was RMB 451,204,236.42 at end-2025 against a budget of RMB 80,395.3 ten-thousand (58.55% of budget invested, progress 58.00%); total construction in progress rose to RMB 661,499,653.28, mainly on this project.
quarterly_data.figure: over 30 grades, over 20 sampled, over 12 in gallon tests, 3 in stable volume supply; 300-ton project construction in progress RMB 451,204,236.42, budget RMB 80,395.3 ten-thousand, progress 58.00%

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (company outlook in the annual report): the company sees AI compute demand and the scaling of domestic semiconductor-material substitution as 2026 tailwinds. It plans to secure supply for existing fab customers' incremental pad demand and extend pads into large silicon wafers, SiC and advanced packaging while accelerating foreign-owned fabs in China and overseas customers; widen CMP slurry and cleaning-solution categories toward a one-stop CMP offering; push through wafer photoresist technical bottlenecks; keep YPI, PSPI and TFE-INK supply growing and push PFAS-free PSPI, BPDL and low-dielectric ink toward mass production, while exploring medium/large-size display, LCD and Micro-LED materials; deepen cooperation with mainstream domestic packaging houses through packaging PI and temporary bonding adhesive; and build a lithium-battery functional auxiliary materials business (binders, dispersants) through the acquisition of 70% of Shenzhen Haofei New Materials, announced in January 2026. It flags that newly built lines (Qianjiang soft pads, Xiantao slurry, abrasive, YPI and PSPI expansions, packaging materials, Qianjiang photoresist) add depreciation and could ramp slower than expected, a risk it calls low-probability.
